proved_scope: On a protected original-coordinate signed core with baseline defect r, top K hostile added eigenvalues arbitrary, residual hostile mean tau_K, and dense tail operator norm delta, any q>=r+K+3 with kappa-delta-q*tau_K/(q-r-K-2)>0 gives density cap 2*sqrt(6*pi*q) divided by that gap. Outside spectrum/couplings unrestricted.
unresolved_implication: The bare condition s3(A)>=1 is not yet known to force a protected physical core with bounded r+K and residual hostile mean below the surviving signed gap, nor an alternative paid cross-energy/volume/ridge/grouped-bank/hub certificate.
next_mechanism: Use the new mean-hostile criterion as one side of an exhaustive structural dichotomy; attack the complementary case where every candidate core has residual hostile mean comparable to its signed gap by aggregate cross-energy/grouped-bank geometry.
